tasks.description: Add a light/dark theme toggle control in the application's Settings page. The toggle should immediately switch the active theme. This control should be accessible and follow the existing design tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the Settings page, when the theme toggle is clicked, then the active theme is switched.

tasks.description: Store the user's selected theme in localStorage so the same theme is applied automatically on the user's next visit. Ensure the storage mechanism is secure and follows best practices.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user closes and reopens the application, then the previously selected theme is applied.

tasks.description: On the first load, when the user has no stored preference, use the prefers-color-scheme media query to choose the initial theme based on the operating system setting.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has no stored theme preference, when the application is loaded, then the theme is set based on the operating system's preferred color scheme.

tasks.description: Ensure the active theme is consistently applied to all pages and shared components of the application, using the existing design tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user navigates to any page or component, then the selected theme is consistently applied.
